core_obligations: Decompose along the affine type: the proof compares the crystals of the moduli spaces with the Fock space crystal component by component, using the author's earlier description of the crystal structure (proof lines 3443-3488).

The tensor product step: the author shows that the crystal of the direct sum of components is the tensor product of the Fock space crystal with the shift by the degree, which is the content of the displayed isomorphism (proof lines 3443-3488).

The unlabelled directions: the identification of the highest-weight components with the Fock space summands uses the author's earlier results on the Fock space and on the affine quiver varieties, invoked as labelled pointers inside the proof (proof lines 3443-3488).
Conclusion: the stated isomorphism between the direct sum of crystals of the quiver varieties and the direct sum of tensor products of Fock space crystals with degree shifts (proof lines 3443-3488).
proof_roadmap: 把两侧的 crystal 按仿射型分解，逐分量比较：左边是各维数向量对应的 quiver variety 的 crystal 直和，右边是 Fock space crystal 与度数移位张量积的直和。
关键一步是把左边分量的 crystal 认成 Fock space 的对应分量再与移位相乘，这一步引用作者前文关于 Fock space 与仿射型 quiver varieties 的结果。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the identification of the crystals attached to the quiver varieties of the extended graph with the Fock space crystals of the affine algebra (author Lemma at source lines 3377-3387, label lem:Fock). The proof (source lines 3443-3488) is the author's own, headed Proof of Lemma lem:Fock, and it is a component-by-component comparison of two crystal structures: the left-hand summands attached to the dimension vectors are matched with the tensor products of the Fock space crystal and the degree shifts, and the identification of the highest-weight pieces uses the author's earlier results on the Fock space and on the affine quiver varieties, which the proof invokes by label. The lemma is one of the two inputs of the author's crystal theorem in the same section. H2.
